subject: The Projects hub cannot link the Cloud Master capstone at all. /projects/index.html navigates to '/projects/<id>.html' by convention (index.html:682), the registry id is cloud-openstack-iac-codify, and the actual page is houses/cloud/openstack/labs/cloud-openstack-project-iac.lab.html -- a different id in a different tree. hasPage:false is therefore CORRECT and must stay (flipping it manufactures a 404), but it means the flagship capstone is invisible on the Projects hub. Decide: add a redirect stub at /projects/cloud-openstack-iac-codify.html, or teach the projects renderer an explicit href field.
